headline: [Exclusive] Energy Supply and Demand: "Strengthening Is Urgent" – Middle East Crisis Highlights Vulnerability, Draft White Paper Revealed: Jiji.com
summary: A draft of Japan's 2025 Energy White Paper says the Middle East crisis disrupted distribution of crude oil and naphtha. It states that fundamental strengthening of supply is urgently needed.
why: Japan imports nearly all of its crude oil, so disruptions in Middle East supply directly affect its energy security and petrochemical feedstock costs.
